---
title: Coding agents
icon: Bot
description: Give your agent the ability to read minified JavaScript.
---

Coding agents hit unreadable minified JavaScript constantly. Left alone, an
agent burns tokens reading through a wall of minified JavaScript and guesses
at what the code does. With the Wakaru skill, it unpacks the bundle
into readable modules, reads only the files it needs, and reasons about real
code instead of guessing. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Grok, and any other
agent that reads the skills format.

## Install

Install via skills.sh:

```bash
npx skills add pionxzh/wakaru
```

## Start using it

Give your agent the file and tell it what you want to understand: how an SDK
behaves, why an error occurs, or how a request is built. Ask as you normally
would, or say "Use Wakaru to analyze this bundle."

The skill gives the agent the instructions it needs to run Wakaru and work
with the recovered code. You can focus on your question without learning
the CLI first.

The [Wakaru skill](https://github.com/pionxzh/wakaru/blob/main/skills/wakaru/SKILL.md)
is available to read or adapt for your own workflow.
